title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities Handle end-to-end recruitment for plant roles (labour, supervisors, QC, maintenance, admin) Maintain daily attendance, shift rosters, leave records and overtime for plant staff and contract labour Process monthly payroll inputs and coordinate PF, ESI and professional tax compliance Maintain statutory records and registers under the Factories Act, Contract Labour Act and Minimum Wages norms Manage onboarding, joining formalities, ID cards, documentation and induction Coordinate with labour contractors on headcount, wages and compliance Handle employee grievances, discipline and exit formalities Support safety training, welfare activities and audit documentation Prepare monthly HR MIS (headcount, attrition, absenteeism, overtime) Preferred candidate profile Graduate or MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field 25 years of HR/admin experience in a manufacturing, agro or food processing plant Working knowledge of PF, ESI, bonus, gratuity and basic labour laws Experience handling large blue-collar workforce and contract labour Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance or payroll software Fluent in Bengali and Hindi, with working English Willing to be based at the plant in Purba Bardhaman Firm yet approachable, able to manage workers and handle conflicts Role & responsibilities 

 Preferred candidate profile

Key Skills: Employee Management,HR Administration,Employee Data Management,HR Ops,Attendance Management,Exit Formalities,Leave Management,Background Verification
